provenance.what: W10 three-arm factor A/B: admission x parallel decode

arms.reuse: shipped: reuse-signal admission, parallel decode on

provenance.design: one build, three arms selected by environment; arm order rotated by round so each arm occupies each slot equally; exact two-sided sign test over per-round ratios within a cell
provenance.why_three_arms: the parallel decode is not gated by SCX_ROW_GROUP_ADMIT, so a two-arm admission A/B holds it constant and cannot measure it at all — which is what job 2964125 did
provenance.what_this_is_not: not a census measurement, and not a claim about cellset_gather, whose own arm caps its hit rate at 8/64 by construction
provenance.arms_verified_by: behaviour, per arm, before every timed invocation
